profile.headline: Cybersecurity SWE @ Microsoft | MIT Sloan MBA Early Admit
profile.summary:
I am a fifth-year dual degree student studying Computer Engineering at Georgia Tech and Computer Science at Emory University. I love bootstrapping groundbreaking ideas into innovative products, most recently when I founded NDA Guru, an AI-based NDA reviewing platform, and developed a product prototype as part of CREATE-X's Idea-to-Prototype (I2P) program.

Over the past year, I developed a passion for cybersecurity by learning about open-source projects and building my own SQL injection vulnerability scanner. A recent highlight of mine was interning on the security team at Microsoft, where I developed a debugging harness that bridges the gap between offensive and defensive security.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a debugger that detects and analyzes crashes of Microsoft applications that open randomly mutated (fuzzed) files. Optimized the debugger’s compatibility with OneFuzz, a cloud-based framework for offensive security testing (fuzz testing). Reduced runtime of fuzz testing by 97% and memory usage by more than 99% through minimal foreign class dependencies. Conducted biweekly demos for the offensive security team to incrementally implement the debugger into live fuzz testing cycles.
positions.insights: Skills: Back-end Operations · Security Engineering · C++ · Fuzz Testing · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Founder and Software Developer @ NDA Guru
positions.description: Founded NDA Guru, an AI-based NDA reviewing platform, and developed a product prototype as part of CREATE-X's Idea-to-Prototype (I2P) program. CREATE-X, an entrepreneurial initiative at Georgia Tech, offers I2P to provide financial, technical, and legal resources to convert a startup idea into a minimum viable product (MVP).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Office Platform

Enabled data syncing between PowerPoint Live add-ins by creating a new framework that merges the Fluid and Office JS API. Constructed an SDK for third-party developers to streamline the process of converting a static add-in to a data-syncing add-in. Consulted Fluid team as they released version 1.0, by ensuring the API and documentation were mature for a stable release. Showcased a production-ready Fluid-leveraged add-in prototype to 200+ Office Platform contributors, managers, and VPs.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Fluid Framework · JavaScript · Data Synchronization

positions.title: Founding President
positions.description: Founded the premier coding club at Emory to prepare students for a career in Computer Science. Hosted three employers and co-sponsored a career fair to improve exploration of, and access to, internship and job opportunities. Pioneered the first Emory weekly coding challenges league to promote competitive coding at a university level.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Passparto is an early-stage start-up that uses AI profiling to tailor marketing campaigns to their customers.

Edited vital step improvements to merge into alpha versions for release to clients/investors using Microsoft Azure repositories. Conducted rapid output testing in C# to ensure logic path accuracy of company applications and live alpha version. Created JSON files to simplify storage of logic-relevant objects that reduced exponential algorithm runtime to linear time.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · HTML/CSS · JavaScript · Early-Stage Startups

projects.title: Audio Monitor Peripheral
projects.description: Designed a peripheral in VHDL that interfaces with the audio-to-digital converter of a computer to process and filter audio. Used assembly language to develop “simple computer” (SCOMP) applications to demo possible uses of the processed audio.

projects.title: MBED Quest Game
projects.description: Programmed a role-playing game (RPG) in C++ on the Keil Studio MBED platform onto a self-constructed gaming circuit. Constructed the gaming circuit by connecting visual, memory, and input peripherals to a microcontroller on a protoboard.
